description: Behavioral regression cases for the documented workflow and scope boundaries.

evals.name: mixed-artifact-routing
evals.prompt: I changed src/api.py, queries/report.sql, .claude/agents/reviewer.md and a brand-logo.svg. Route each artifact to its optimizer without executing those optimizers.
evals.expected_output: A four-row routing plan names /cdo, /dqo, /ado and /deso respectively, with no consequential execution.

assertions.name: four rows
assertions.check: The routing plan contains exactly four target rows.

assertions.name: correct specialists
assertions.check: Each of the four artifacts is assigned to its matching optimizer.

assertions.name: no execution
assertions.check: No optimizer, database action or live service is executed.

evals.name: read-only-prompt-preservation
evals.prompt: A folder sweep includes src/prompts/support.txt and the user requested inspection only. How should the router dispatch it?
evals.expected_output: Select prompt-deep-optimizer, preserve its report-only default and the user read-only constraint; do not infer --write.

assertions.name: prompt route
assertions.check: Selects prompt-deep-optimizer for the prompt artifact.

assertions.name: no write inference
assertions.check: Does not add --write or authorize file changes from a generic sweep.

evals.name: resume-coverage
evals.prompt: The sweep ledger has a.py done at the unchanged hash, b.sql failed, and c.md pending. Resume and explain what remains.
evals.expected_output: Retain the unchanged completion, preserve the failure without silent retry, and dispatch only pending c.md through prose review.

assertions.name: completed retained
assertions.check: Keeps a.py complete when its content hash is unchanged.

assertions.name: failure retained
assertions.check: Reports b.sql failed instead of silently retrying or marking it complete.

assertions.name: pending route
assertions.check: Routes c.md through the prose member and reports open counts.
